_review: reference translation (from zh_simp), unreviewed by a native speaker
_hud: HUD text labels live in this table (`hud.*` keys): the zh_simp values are the literal on-screen HUD strings (full-width spaces included). The HUD (`disp/src/i18n.rs`) reads `resource/i18n/<lang>.json` once at startup into a read-only table, drops the JSON text, and looks labels up per frame without allocating. The language comes from the config `language` key (`auto` = follow the system) and takes effect after a HUD restart.
_vars: {name} / {n} in a value are placeholders substituted by t(key, {...})

update.title: Flight model database update
update.switch: U P D A T E   T O   D O W N L O A D E D
update.first_time: No local data yet — you can download it
update.ready: Download and verification are complete — ready to update
update.hud_running: The HUD (wp8f.exe) is running: close it before updating (the updater will not end it for you)
update.done: Switched to the new data: restart the HUD to take effect
update.json_needed: This build has no fm-json support: upstream data is JSON and will not parse — rebuild with scripts/build.sh first
update.manifest_local: File list came from the local old data: new upstream files cannot be discovered
update.confirm_switch: Switching renames the current data to {old} (only the previous version is kept — delete it to free space; rolling back just swaps the two names).
update.dropped: These top-level directories are not part of the update and will not be in the new data root: {list}.
update.confirm_hud: The HUD must be restarted to read the new data.
update.legal: Data comes from a third-party unlicensed repository (War-Thunder-Datamine): local use only, never redistributed.
update.discard: C L E A R   D O W N L O A D
update.err.hud_running: The HUD is running — close it before updating
update.no_staging: Nothing has been fully downloaded yet: click “Start download” first
update.verify.running: Verifying the downloaded folder (size + JSON parse)…
update.err.discard: Failed to clear the download folder: {err}
update.discarded: Download folder cleared (data_new and the temp folder)
update.discard_confirm: Clearing the download folder deletes data_new and the temp files; everything must be downloaded again.
update.err.permission: Permission denied (the directory may be in use)
